cohort: The study participants were 440 women with singleton small-for-gestational-age (SGA) pregnancies between 32.0 and 36.9 weeks' gestation, derived from a larger Dutch multicenter cohort study.
finding: A prediction model incorporating estimated fetal weight (EFW) at inclusion, sFlt-1/PlGF ratio at inclusion, and highest umbilicocerebral ratio (UCR) was most effective for predicting composite adverse perinatal outcome (CAPO) in SGA pregnancies.
mod_finding: A higher number of (emergency) Cesarean sections were performed in the group that experienced the composite adverse perinatal outcome (CAPO).
birth_weight: Median birth weight was 1.993 kg for neonates with CAPO and 2.518 kg for those without CAPO.
gest_age: Gestational age at inclusion was 32.0-36.9 weeks; median gestational age at birth was 37.0 weeks for neonates with CAPO and 38.3 weeks for those without CAPO.
